s: Seder ereb yom kippur ubo z' seipim: "veinnitem et napshotekem betisha lachodesh vego', veki betisha mitannin? Vahalo en mitannin ella baasiri, shenneemar "beasor lachodesh teannu et napshotekem", veneemar "meereb ad ereb vego'", ella inyan hakkatub hakinu atzmekem batteshii leinnuy haasiri, shettoklu vetishtu batteshii kede shettukelu lehitannot baasiri, vehu meahabat haqqadosh baruk hu leyisrael, shello tzivvam lehitannot ella yom echad bashshana uletobatam lekapper avonotehem, vetzivvam sheyyoklu veyishtu techilla shello yazziq lahem hainnuy. Umah shehotzi hakkatub et haakila bilshon innuy velo amar beperush sheyyoklu veyishtu batteshii, lomar leka shehaokel veshoteh batteshii — maaleh alayv hakkatub keillu haya mitanneh bo mechamat mitzvat haqqadosh baruk hu shetztzivva lehitannot bo, sheen sekar haokel veshoteh mechamat mitzvat haqqadosh baruk hu domeh liskar hammitanneh mechamat mitzvat haqqadosh baruk hu, abal zeh sheokel veshoteh batteshii sekaro harbeh meod keillu haya mitanneh (batteshii ubaasiri) mechamat mitzvat haqqadosh baruk hu shetztzivva lehitannot (bishnehem). Dekevan sheyyom hakkippurim beatzmo i epshar lekabbedo bemaakal ubemishteh kederek shemmekabbedin shear yom tob — tzarik lekabbedo bayyom shellepanayv. Lepikak asur lehitannot bo apillu taanit chalom, ap al pi shemmuttar lehitannot taanit chalom apillu beshabbat veyom tob, mikkol maqom beereb yom hakkippurim shehaakila nechshebet keinnuy kemo shennitbaer — en lehitannot bo, ella yokal veyishteh, veyechasheb lo keillu hitanna al chalomo. Umikkol maqom, mi sheyyirtzeh lehitannot al chalomo ad seuda hammapseqet — en limchot beyado, lepi sheereb yom hakkippurim eno domeh leshabbat shenneemar bo "veqarata lashshabbat oneg", ulepikak asur lehitannot bo apillu shaa achat leshem taanit im eno taanit chalom kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"ch, abal beereb yom hakkippurim shello neemar bo oneg ella shemmitzva leekol bo, veim akal paam achat bayyom — yatza yede chobato:

Veim abar vetaa vehitanna kol hayyom — tzarik lehitannot achar yom hakkippurim taanit a' lekapper al mah shehitanna beereb yom hakkippurim. Abal im lo hitanna ella ad seuda hammapseqet — eno tzarik lehitannot achar yom hakkippurim:
Im nadar lehitannot bo — ayyen besiman tq"a:

Ap al pi shemmin haddin ereb yom hakkippurim muttar behesped sheeno yom tob kelal veen bo maala ella shemmitzva leekol bo, mikkol maqom nohagin laashoto yom tob, veen maspidin bo ella al chakam bepanayv, o beyom shebbaa shemuato shemmet shehu kemo bepanayv kemo shennitbaer besiman tqm"z ayyen sham, veken en omerim tzidduq haddin ella al chakam bepanayv. Veken en omerim bo tachanun, vegam en omerim qodem alot hashshachar harbeh selichot kebishar yamim. Veyesh meqomot nohagin leharbot bislichot, lepi sheen choshebin oto yom tob ella mealot hashshachar vaelak abal lo ballayla. Vehakkol lepi hamminhag:

Mi shennoheg shello leekol basar bekol yemot hachol ki im beyom sheen omerim bo tachanun — muttar leekol basar apillu belel ereb yom hakkippurim, vekol shekken bayyom. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimqomot sheen omerim harbeh selichot ballayla, shehen choshebin leyom tob gam et hallayla, abal bimqomot shemmarbim bislichot sheen choshebin et hallayla leyom tob — en leekol basar ballayla. Vaapillu bimqomot sheen marbim bo bislichot — lo yokal basar qodem tzet hakkokabim shel lel ereb yom kippur, ap al pi shehitpallel arbit mibbeod yom, lepi sheen choshebin leyom tob ella layla mammash, shehare omerim tachanun achar tepillat hammincha shel ch' tishre, ubishar yamim sheen omerim bahem tachanun en omerim tachanun apillu bemincha shellipnehem, mikkelal sheereb yom kippur en machaziqin leyom tob ella mitztzet hakkokabim vaelak:
En omerim "lamnatztzeach yaanka vego'", sheeno yom tzara. Veen omerim bo "mizmor letoda", mittaam shennitbaer besiman n"a ayyen sham:

En omerim bo "abinu malkenu", lo bitpillat shacharit velo bemincha. Veyesh meqomot nohagin keshechal yom hakkippurim beshabbat sheen omerim bo "abinu malkenu" kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"t, az omerim oto beereb yom hakkippurim shacharit:
